'''Kinch Sunka''' was an individual who became a [[Beast-Lord]], the leader of the [[Beast Riders]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Sunka lead the first Beast Rider attack on the city [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], beginning a conflict on Onderon that would last for centuries.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
